summary.text: Andrea Kirby is the Working Class Party candidate for Michigan's 10th District and has appeared on general-election ballots for U.S. House in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Kirby ran for U.S. House in Michigan's 9th District in 2018 and 2020.
She ran in Michigan's 10th District in 2022 and 2024, and in 2024 she received 2.6% of the vote as the Working Class Party candidate.
The Working Class Party nominated her at its convention on June 6, 2026.
